title: Hima-Ten!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Tenichi, a high schooler skilled at home economics, earns money with a part-time job cleaning houses. Himari, the teenage owner and model of a popular cosmetics brand, transfers into his class, and a romantic comedy grows between the company president and the house cleaner. Database tags list a love triangle and several girls interested in Tenichi.
life_message: Diligent, unglamorous work and care for others' homes earn respect and affection, and a public image can hide a messier real self.
